title: Mayfield NSW - Upgrade the Network
current_summary:
Planned upgrade work is under way in Mayfield, NSW, within the window of 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM AEDT on Tuesday 20 October. A single interruption of up to 60 minutes is scheduled from around 12:30 AM AEDT.

Our network partner is upgrading equipment that carries traffic from the local area into the wider network. Your service will drop out briefly while this happens and should reconnect by itself.

nbn is upgrading equipment in the Aggregation Network at the POI (Point of Interconnect) in anticipation of emerging capacity needs from network growth. nbn undertakes this work during the night-time to minimise impact to customers. During and post a change window there will be delays in the processing of Orders (AVC, CVC, NNI). RSPs may continue to successfully submit Orders via the nbn Service Portal and API.

nbn® is completing upgrades on the nbn network in your area. This will cause your nbn service to lose connection.
Using mobile data where available can help you stay connected while your service is offline. Minimise disruption to your routine by downloading required files and switching to offline work modes.

updates.content: We will be supporting planned upgrades by our network partner in Mayfield, NSW between 12:00 AM and 6:00 AM AEDT on Tuesday 20 October. During this window, some customers in the area may experience a brief loss of internet service. A single interruption of up to 60 minutes is currently scheduled to begin around 12:30 AM AEDT. We will monitor progress and aim to minimise disruption. Services should come back online automatically once the work is finished. Please note that new orders and service changes may process more slowly during and shortly after the window. If your connection does not return after 6:00 AM AEDT, try restarting your modem/router. If issues persist, contact our support team.

The planned upgrade work in Mayfield, NSW has now started. The interruption of up to 60 minutes is still scheduled from around 12:30 AM AEDT, and services should reconnect automatically once the work is complete.
